_comment: Copy to .work/applicant.json and edit. Gitignored, unlike this file. These are the answers application FORMS ask for; profile.json holds the skills the SCORER reads. Two files because this one carries a phone number and a salary, and it is filled into forms unattended.
_india: The three fields below are what Indian application forms screen on. Leave one null and auto-apply REFUSES any form that asks for it, rather than guessing a number into a binding field.
_visa: false = you can work without sponsorship where you are applying. The mapper flips this correctly for both phrasings a form might use.
_resume: Must exist on disk or the guard blocks every application. Annual figures above are total rupees, not lakhs.
